B-grounded.context_rule: receives, injected into its context before the question, the same committed artifact records the kernel's answer rests on - scoped to the referenced record(s) named by the task's artifact_refs (the node record, the twin group entry, the closure's registration plus the routes and states for the queried world), extracted verbatim, not whole ledger files
B-grounded.correctness: scored by the same checks as the kernel (exact / receipt-content / verdict-content containment against the task book's expected record); B-grounded is a genuine contender and may win (C3), which falsifies the thesis at this scale

prompt_template.system: Answer using only the provided materials. If the materials do not determine the answer, say so instead of guessing.

B-ungrounded.context_rule: none - the same model answering cold; expected to fail correctness on corpus-specific tasks; the gap between the arms is the grounding story told in numbers

committed: before any timed run, per DESIGN-grounded-throughput §6 T4; K = 5 freezes at this commit

host.assignment: the baseline gets the GPU; the kernel is CPU-bound I/O on the same machine; nothing else heavy runs during the registered run (house rule: never two heavy suites at once)
host.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 Laptop GPU, 16303 MiB

runtime.api: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, streamed, same client library as the kernel arm

context.amended: 2026-08-22, before any timed run; replaces an earlier same-day num_ctx amendment that review proved inert at the /v1 layer and unrunnable at 262144 on this GPU
context.mechanism: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH environment variable on the serving process; the OpenAI-compat /v1 layer ignores a num_ctx body field (verified live 2026-08-22), so the setting must be server-side and the run must record the observed context_length from /api/ps
context.pre_declared_secondary: declared 2026-08-22, before any timed run: beside T4-s registered median over all half-B answerable tasks, the result reports the same median restricted to tasks whose B-grounded materials fit the observed context untruncated. The registered gate is the former; the latter is reported so a reader can see how much of K is carried by tasks the baseline could not physically hold.
context.truncation_disclosure: the largest closure MATERIALS block measures ~130k tokens - full closure grounding does not fit this hardware in any configuration. The stopwatch records materials_chars and materials_tokens per task; any task whose materials exceed the observed context is reported materials-truncated in the result.
context.why_32768: the largest value whose KV cache fits the 16 GiB GPU (~5 GiB at 32k for qwen3-4b; 131072+ needs more VRAM than the machine has and would spill the model to CPU, a strawman in the other direction). ollama default 4096 would silently truncate most grounded materials.

sampling.source: vendor defaults as shipped in the ollama model manifest; not tuned by this repository

sanity.note: informational only; the registered run's own measurements govern

tokenizer.policy: gitignored local file, digest-pinned here; token counting REFUSES (exit 2) when the file is absent or its digest mismatches - cannot-verify, never skip (the WordNet-archive rule)

warmup: both contenders warm: one unmeasured warmup request per system before the run; the baseline model is loaded and resident before timing starts
